title: World Map Interchange consumer capability profile (experimental draft 0.1.0)
description: Describes what a consuming application can interpret. Used to report supported, retained and unsupported layers separately from package conformance.

quantities.description: Quantity ids the consumer interprets, or the string 'registry' for every registry quantity.

retain_unrecognised.description: If true, readable layers whose quantity is not recognised are preserved (bytes and metadata) without interpretation.

required_quantities.description: Workflow requirements. Unmet requirements are reported, but they never make a package non-conformant.
